name: itinerary-planner-static-vanilla-js
description: Multi-Day Trip Itinerary Planner, Hotels & Time Zone Hub built with Static HTML + Vanilla JavaScript (Zero-Bundler ES Modules) and modern Google Maps Platform APIs.

scripts.build: node --check app.js && node --check server.mjs && node -e "import('node:fs').then((fs)=>{for (const f of ['index.html','app.js','styles.css','server.mjs','package.json','.env.example','.gitignore','README.md','AGENTS.md']){if(!fs.existsSync(f))throw new Error('Missing '+f);}}).catch((e)=>{console.error(e);process.exit(1);})"
